description: This file defines a React functional component 'AddAutoRouterTab' used for creating an auto routing configuration within a UI. It includes form handling, validation, model fetching, connection testing, and configuration building related to auto routing features.

methods.name: handleTestConnection
methods.description: Initiates a connection test when 'Test Connect' button is clicked, updating modal visibility and test ID.

methods.name: handleAutoRouterSubmit
methods.description: Validates the form fields and router configuration, then submits the data for creating an auto router using 'handleAddAutoRouterSubmit'.
